collection.title: BMW 6 Series Coupe 2011 to 2017 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a BMW 6 Series Coupe 2011 - 2017 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 17" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
